mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an alkyl halide and an aldehyde or ketone."
The starting materials are an alkyl halide and an aldehyde or ketone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any chemical reaction involving gaining of electrons."
Definitions Reduction is any chemical reaction involving gaining of electrons.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very reactive molecule (an oxidizing agent) and is able to break the σ and π bonds in alkenes and alkynes, but it does not break isolated C-C single σ bonds."
Ozone is a very reactive molecule (an oxidizing agent) and is able to break the σ and π bonds in alkenes and alkynes, but it does not break isolated C-C single σ bonds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the method of choice for the reduction of carboxylic acids to primary alcohols."
Reaction with lithium aluminium hydride is the method of choice for the reduction of carboxylic acids to primary alcohols.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more powerful reducing agent than sodium boriohydride and reduces most of the commonly encountered organic functional groups."
Lithium aluminium hydride is a more powerful reducing agent than sodium boriohydride and reduces most of the commonly encountered organic functional groups.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ester of boric acid and an alcohol, a trialkyl borate."
The initial product is the ester of boric acid and an alcohol, a trialkyl borate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a predictable and reliable method for the synthesis of a wide range of alkenes, often with high E- or Z-stereoselectivity."
The Wittig reaction (and its variants) is a predictable and reliable method for the synthesis of a wide range of alkenes, often with high E- or Z-stereoselectivity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the overall substitution of a C=O bond with a C=C bond."
The Wittig reaction is the overall substitution of a C=O bond with a C=C bond.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered as a loss of electrons."
Definitions Oxidation in inorganic chemistry is considered as a loss of electrons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important reactions of alkenes."
Oxidation is one of the most important reactions of alkenes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a convenient way to synthesize a functionalized larger molecule from smaller starting reagents."
Condensation reactions are a convenient way to synthesize a functionalized larger molecule from smaller starting reagents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most frequently used catalysts."
Platinum and palladium are the most frequently used catalysts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a convenient way of making larger molecules containing an alkyne function."
nucleophilic substitution reaction is a convenient way of making larger molecules containing an alkyne function.
